primary_sources.read_scope: Definitions of floor/ceiling and scalar iteration; complete Theorem 3 on journal p245 and complete Section4 proof on journal p249. Other theorems are not independent premises of this audit.

primary_sources.finding: The same lower-complexity constant and divisibility-versus-real-growth mechanism are published. The signed finite-state rational extension must be proved separately; the candidate does so. Direct scalar-ceiling theorem application is invalid and not claimed by the supplement.
